## What happened

Describe the expected and actual behavior, and the steps to reproduce.

## Relevant result

For a recovery command, include its result text and profile readiness. For a connection issue, say whether it happens on Wi-Fi, cellular or both, and whether the last contact time updates.

Remove locations, photos, credentials, keys, public endpoint addresses and pairing bundles before attaching logs or screenshots. For a vulnerability, use SECURITY.md instead of posting details here.
